title: Multi-marketplace pricing and listing synchronization
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Coordinate and deliver synchronized listing updates, pricing SKU mapping, and release notes across AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplace channels for the Redwood Inference hosted offering. Scope includes canonical PRD for marketplace copy, standardized SKU/pricing table for each vendor, telemetry/metering contract checks, packaging artifacts (AMI/container/VM images or SaaS offer metadata), legal/publisher verification steps, and go-to-market assets (docs, sales brief, partner ops handoff). Out of scope: Dedicated capacity private offers and on-prem image builds beyond required listing artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Unified pricing table published and approved by Finance with per-cloud SKU mapping
Marketplace listings (AWS SaaS, Azure Marketplace Offer, GCP Marketplace) submitted with vendor-specific required fields and screenshots
Release notes and product copy reviewed by PM, Legal, and Docs and staged in vendor portals
Metering/integration smoke test passed for at least one representative plan per cloud
Partner Ops and Sales enablement deck delivered and shared with AMs
Rollout playbook created with rollback criteria and monitoring checklist

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Azure publisher verification delay can block publish. Mitigation: start publisher verification immediately and prepare fallback to publish 'preview' with limited availability.
Risk: Metering integration mismatch could cause billing errors. Mitigation: end-to-end smoke test and coordinate with Finance to enable manual reconciliation for first billing cycle.
Risk: Copy inconsistencies across portals leading to support tickets. Mitigation: single-source-of-truth doc (Confluence) and content freeze 48h before submission.
Risk: Feature gating differences across clouds. Mitigation: ensure offer metadata clearly indicates feature parity and use rollouts to gate new capabilities.
Risk: Acceptance delays from vendor marketplaces. Mitigation: submit early and designate Marketplace Ops to escalate with vendor partner reps.
